title: Consolidation: Paprika, Tokaj & Terroir: A Cultural History of Hungarian Cuisine

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can summarize the major epochs of Hungarian culinary and viticultural history from King Matthias to the modern gastronomic revolution.
I can fluently apply resultative sublative expressions (puhára, pirosra, aranybarnára, sűrűre, omlósra) to describe cooking processes.
I can craft nuanced sensory comparisons using mintha + conditional to evaluate food, wine, and hospitality.
